events.question: How many paying customers are on the Team plan right now?

plan.headline: Counts distinct non-test organizations with a paying Team-plan subscription as of today, plus its trend.

metrics.title: Paying Team customers
metrics.description: Number of distinct organizations with a current subscription on a Team-tier plan, a status that counts as paying, and MRR above zero, as of today.

metrics.title: Paying Team customers by week
metrics.description: Weekly count of distinct organizations with a paying Team-plan subscription active at the end of each week over the selected period.

assumptions.label: Paying statuses
assumptions.rationale: Trialing subscriptions have not paid yet, so by default only active subscriptions count. Past-due customers still owe money but are excluded unless you choose otherwise.

assumptions.label: Include legacy plans
assumptions.rationale: Legacy plans with Team tier are still Team customers, so they are included by default.

assumptions.label: Exclude test accounts
assumptions.rationale: QA, demo and load-test organizations are not real customers, per the data dictionary.

assumptions.label: Minimum MRR
assumptions.rationale: Requiring MRR above zero keeps free or fully discounted subscriptions out of the paying count.

assumptions.label: Timezone
assumptions.rationale: Determines where week boundaries fall in the trend chart.

assumptions.label: Trend period
assumptions.rationale: The last 6 months shows recent movement in Team customers without too much noise.

events.label: Writing SQL
events.detail: The tricky part is determining "active at end of week" when I only have current status rather than historic…

events.sql:
WITH team_subs AS (
  SELECT s.org_id
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE p.tier = 'team'
    AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR NOT p.is_legacy)
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND s.mrr_cents >= :min_mrr_cents::int
    AND s.mrr_cents > 0
    AND (
      s.status = 'active'
      OR (:paying_statuses::text = 'active + past_due' AND s.status = 'past_due')
    )
    AND s.canceled_at IS NULL
    AND s.started_at < (:as_of::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC'
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT org_id) AS value
FROM team_subs
events.explanation: Counts distinct non-test orgs with a current (not canceled, started by today) Team-tier subscription in a paying status and MRR at or above the minimum and above zero.

events.sql:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT w::date AS week_start,
         -- snapshot at end of week, capped at the (exclusive) end of the range
         (LEAST(w + interval '7 days', (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp)) AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS snap
  FROM generate_series(
    date_trunc('week', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp),
    ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp,
    interval '7 days'
  ) AS w
),
paying_team_subs AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.started_at, s.canceled_at
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE p.tier = 'team'
    AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR NOT p.is_legacy)
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND s.mrr_cents >= :min_mrr_cents::int
    -- historical status is unknown: ended rows (canceled) are assumed to have been paying while open
    AND (s.status = 'canceled'
         OR s.status = 'active'
         OR (s.status = 'past_due' AND :paying_statuses::text = 'active + past_due'))
)
SELECT w.week_start AS x,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.org_id) AS y
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN paying_team_subs s
  ON s.started_at < w.snap
 AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= w.snap)
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start
events.explanation: For each week, counts distinct non-test orgs with a Team-tier subscription (MRR at least the minimum, paying status) that had started and not yet been canceled at the end of that week.

review.summary: The count is essentially correct for today's defaults, but a hardcoded MRR filter ignores the editable Minimum MRR setting when it is lowered to 0, so I removed that filter.

issues.message: Hardcoded `s.mrr_cents > 0` overrides the `:min_mrr_cents` assumption (min 0). Remove it so `s.mrr_cents >= :min_mrr_cents::int` alone controls the threshold.

review.summary: The weekly trend runs and is broadly right, but it counts every canceled Team subscription as paying for its whole lifetime, so trials that never converted inflate past weeks; the rewrite only counts canceled rows that have a paid invoice.

issues.message: paying_team_subs treats every s.status = 'canceled' row as paying while it was open, so canceled trials (and past_due rows when 'active only' is chosen) inflate historical weeks; require evidence of payment, e.g. EXISTS a paid invoice for the subscription.

generate_series starts at date_trunc('week', :date_range_start), so the first x (2026-04-27) falls before the range start; acceptable for weekly buckets but be aware that the first point precedes the selected period.

WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT w::date AS week_start,
         (LEAST(w + interval '7 days', (:date_range_end::date)::timestamp)) AT TIME ZONE :timezone::text AS snap
  FROM generate_series(
    date_trunc('week', (:date_range_start::date)::timestamp),
    ((:date_range_end::date) - 1)::timestamp,
    interval '7 days'
  ) AS w
),
paying_team_subs AS (
  SELECT s.org_id, s.started_at, s.canceled_at
  FROM northwind.subscriptions s
  JOIN northwind.plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id
  JOIN northwind.organizations o ON o.id = s.org_id
  WHERE p.tier = 'team'
    AND (:include_legacy_plans::boolean OR NOT p.is_legacy)
    AND (NOT :exclude_test_accounts::boolean OR NOT o.is_test)
    AND s.mrr_cents >= :min_mrr_cents::int
    AND (s.status = 'active'
         OR (s.status = 'past_due' AND :paying_statuses::text = 'active + past_due')
         OR (s.status = 'canceled' AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM northwind.invoices i
               WHERE i.subscription_id = s.id AND i.status = 'paid')))
)
SELECT w.week_start AS x,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.org_id) AS y
FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN paying_team_subs s
  ON s.started_at < w.snap
 AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at >= w.snap)
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start
